description: Headline annual financials for a public company from its latest 10-K/20-F/40-F XBRL data on SEC EDGAR: revenue, net_income, operating_income, eps_diluted, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity and cash. Each metric gives value, unit, the us-gaap concept used, period_start, period_end, fiscal_year, form, filed date and accession_number; a metric is null when the company doesn't report it under the standard us-gaap concept (common for IFRS filers and banks). Pass exactly one of `ticker` or `cik`. Returns "not_found" when EDGAR has no annual us-gaap data. Paid: $0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402; failed lookups are not charged.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"

name: get_sec_financials
title: Get SEC financials
